name: fix75_quickbar
verifies: fix-75 #2/#6: in the inventory the digit keys put the selected stack on the quick bar (G3 OnPlayerAssignStackKey): weapons, ammo, food, potions, torches go on, a ring is refused (eff_inv_deny_01); an occupied slot gets the new stack, the same stack moves out of its old slot; hovering a stack selects it and shows it in the item panel [owner]; the bar is saved
notes: quickslot:<item> is the 0-based slot (key 1 = 0 ... key 0 = 9), -1 = not on the bar. invquick fails when the item panel does not show the selected/hovered stack.
